parents.subject: Less Commonly Taught Languages
parents.course: Advanced Course in a Less Commonly Taught Language I

ns2:section.sectionText: Advanced Finnish II, a continuation of Advanced Finnish I. Course includes a discussion of novels, short stories, plays, articles. Structural, stylistic, vocabulary-building exercises. This section is offered through the BTAA Course Share Program hosted by University of Minnesota and will be video-conference/Zoom/online taught for participating universities.
